title: Osthe
desc: Velan dislikes his father and his half-brother Balan. As a police officer, he locks horns with a local politician who uses the hostility between the brothers as an advantage.

title: Joseph
desc: Following the death of his ex-wife, a retired police officer, who is known for his investigative prowess, unexpectedly gets pulled into a criminal case involving organ harvesting.

title: Paruthiveeran
desc: A young, carefree man, Paruthiveeran, saves Muththazhagu's life, and they eventually fall in love. However, their families object to their union, forcing the couple to elope together.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

title: Dharma Durai
desc: Dharmadurai, a heartbroken doctor, turns to alcohol and becomes the source of embarrassment for his family. However, a meeting with an old friend changes his life for good.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Mr Asok
desc: A young man's task of wooing a woman he has fallen in love with becomes difficult when her father decides to marry her elsewhere.
